en-e1-l1.title: Alphabet and initial sounds
en-e1-l1.concept: Words are easier to remember when you know their first sound and first letter. Try reading them aloud.

en-e1-l2.title: Greetings
en-e1-l2.concept: Say **Hello** when you meet someone and **Goodbye** when you leave. Say your name with **My name is ...**.

en-e1-l3.title: Numbers and colors
en-e1-l3.concept: Learn number words like one, two, three... and color words like red, blue, yellow... .

en-e1-l4.title: Family
en-e1-l4.concept: These are words for family members, such as mother (uwa), father (uba), grandmother (kaka), and baby (jariri).

en-e1-l5.title: Classroom words
en-e1-l5.concept: Try saying words used in the classroom, such as desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... in English.

en-e2-l1.title: Names of animals and things
en-e2-l1.concept: Words that name things, such as rabbit (zomo), bird (tsuntsu), and fish (kifi), are called **nouns**.

en-e2-l2.title: Words for actions
en-e2-l2.concept: Words that describe actions, such as jump (tsalle), run (gudu), and eat (ci), are called **verbs**.

en-e2-l3.concept: **I like ...** means 'Ina son ...', and **I have ...** means 'Ina da ...'.

en-e2-l4.title: Making short sentences
en-e2-l4.concept: Use **am** after I and **are** after You. Sentences follow the order 'who → what they are like/what they do'.

en-e2-l5.title: Reading short passages
en-e2-l5.concept: When reading, first look for words from the question in the passage.

en-e3-abc1.title: Uppercase and lowercase letters
en-e3-abc1.concept: The alphabet has **uppercase** and **lowercase** letters. Since many pairs have different shapes, learn them one pair at a time. Be especially careful with similar-looking letters such as b, d, p, and q.

en-e3-l1.title: Making sentences
en-e3-l1.concept: Sentences follow the order 'who → does what → what'. Add **-s** to the verb after He, She, or a person's name.

en-e3-l2.title: Pronouns
en-e3-l2.concept: You can use **He**, **She**, **It**, **They**, or **We** instead of a name.

en-e3-l3.title: Present and past tenses
en-e3-l3.concept: Use the **present tense** for things happening now or repeatedly. For past events, use the **past tense**, which often adds **-ed** to the end of the verb.

en-e3-l4.title: Daily routine
en-e3-l4.concept: Try talking about your daily routine in English: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... .

en-e3-l5.title: Understanding a passage
en-e3-l5.concept: When reading a passage, find who did what and when.

en-e3-snd1.title: Dangantakar sauti da haruffa
en-e3-snd1.concept: Sautin farko da harafin farko na kalma suna da alaƙa. Koyi dangantakar sauti da haruffa ta hanyar gano kalmomin da suke farawa da sauti ɗaya. Wasu lokuta haruffa biyu kamar ph suna yin sautin f.

en-e4-l1.title: Yanzu, baya da nan gaba
en-e4-l1.concept: Ana bayyana abin da ke faruwa yanzu ko abin da ake maimaitawa da **present tense**; abin da ya faru a baya da **-ed**; abin da zai faru nan gaba kuma da **will + tushen aikatau**.

en-e4-l2.title: Tambaya da jimla mara korewa
en-e4-l2.concept: Tambaya tana farawa da **Do/Does**; don faɗin a’a, ana amfani da **don't/doesn't**.

en-e4-l3.title: Kalmomin siffa da ji
en-e4-l3.concept: Waɗannan kalmomi suna bayyana siffa ko ji, kamar big (babba), small (ƙarami), hot (mai zafi), da cold (mai sanyi).

en-e4-l4.title: Kalmomin wuri
en-e4-l4.concept: Ana bayyana wurin abu da **on** (a saman), **in** (a ciki), **under** (a ƙasa da), da **behind** (a bayan).

en-e4-l5.title: Karanta ɗan gajeren rubutu
en-e4-l5.concept: Nemo amsar a cikin rubutun: wa ya yi me, kuma a ina?

en-e5-l1.title: Articles, jam’i, da There is/are
en-e5-l1.concept: Ana amfani da **an** kafin sautin wasali, **a** kuma kafin sautin baƙi. Idan abu ɗaya ne, yi amfani da **There is**; idan abubuwa sun fi ɗaya, yi amfani da **There are**.

en-e5-l2.title: Kalmomin kwatantawa
en-e5-l2.concept: Don kwatanta abubuwa biyu, yi amfani da **-er + than**; don bayyana abin da ya fi duka, yi amfani da **the -est**. Ana amfani da **more** ga kalmomi masu tsawo.

en-e5-l3.title: Bayyana nan gaba
en-e5-l3.concept: Ana bayyana abin da zai faru nan gaba da **will + tushen aikatau** ko **be going to + tushen aikatau**.

en-e5-l4.title: Sake rubuta jimla
en-e5-l4.concept: A jimla mara korewa, ana amfani da **not / don't / doesn't / didn't**; a tambaya kuma ana saka **Are / Do / Does** a farkon jimla.

en-e5-l5.title: Fahimtar rubutu
en-e5-l5.concept: A cikin dogon rubutu, yana da sauƙi a nemo amsa idan ka karanta kana neman wa, ina, yaushe da me.

en-e6-l1.title: Taƙaitaccen bitar lokutan aikatau
en-e6-l1.concept: Ana bayyana abin da ke faruwa yanzu da **be + -ing**; abin da ya faru a baya da **past tense**; abin da zai faru nan gaba kuma da **will / be going to**.

en-e6-l2.concept: Bayan **can** (iya), **must** (dole), **should** (ya kamata), da **may** (ana iya), ana amfani da tushen aikatau.

en-e6-l3.title: Faɗaɗa ƙamus
en-e6-l3.concept: Idan ka koyi kalmomi masu ma’ana iri ɗaya da kishiyoyinsu tare, ƙamus ɗinka zai ninka.

en-e6-l5.title: Karanta sakin layi
en-e6-l5.concept: Karanta rubutu mai jimloli da yawa, sannan ka nemo amsar wa, yaushe da me ya sa aka yi abin.

en-e6-pun1.title: Babban harafi da alamomin rubutu
en-e6-pun1.concept: Jimla tana farawa da **babban harafi** kuma tana ƙarewa da **alamar rubutu** da ta dace. Yawanci ana amfani da full stop (.) a jimla, question mark (?) a tambaya, da exclamation mark (!) don mamaki ko ƙarfafa magana. Sunayen mutane da I kullum suna farawa da babban harafi.

en-e6-seq1.title: Fahimtar jerin abubuwan da suka faru
en-e6-seq1.concept: Za ka iya gane jerin abubuwan da suka faru ta hanyar neman kalmomin jere kamar **First** (na farko), **Then / Next** (sannan / na gaba), **After that** (bayan haka), da **Finally** (a ƙarshe).

en-h1-l1.title: Perfect tense da perfect progressive
en-h1-l1.concept: **had + p.p.** yana nuna abin da ya faru kafin wani abu a baya; **have been -ing** kuma yana nuna aikin da ya ci gaba har zuwa yanzu.

en-h1-l2.title: Relative adverbs da noun clauses
en-h1-l2.concept: where / when / why su ne relative words masu aikin adverb; whether / that kuma suna gabatar da noun clause.

en-h1-l3.title: Ginin jimlar participle
en-h1-l3.concept: A rage conjunction da subject, sannan a mayar da verb zuwa -ing. Subject ɗin da ake nufi dole ya zama iri ɗaya.

en-h1-l4.title: Linking words da tsarin rubutu
en-h1-l4.concept: A bambanta dalili–sakamako (so, therefore), saɓani (however), misali (for example), da ƙari (in addition).

en-h1-l5.title: Fahimtar babban ra’ayi da cike gurbi ta hasashe
en-h1-l5.concept: Babban ra’ayi yana cikin ɓangaren bayan However da ke juya ra’ayin da aka saba, da kuma jimlar ƙarshe. A yi hasashe kan gurbi ta hanyar bin matsala → mafita → sakamako.

en-h2-l1.title: Inversion da tsarin jaddadawa
en-h2-l1.concept: Idan Never/Hardly/Only then ya zo a farkon jimla, tsarin zama auxiliary verb + subject ne. A yi amfani da It is ~ that domin jaddadawa.

en-h2-l2.title: Yanayin zato
en-h2-l2.concept: A cikin I wish / as if / If clause, a yi amfani da past tense don abin da ya saɓa da yanzu, da had p.p. don abin da ya saɓa da baya.

en-h2-l3.title: Complex relatives da subordinate clauses na rangwame
en-h2-l3.concept: whatever, whoever, whichever, however + adjective na nufin “komai..., ko da kuwa...”.

en-h2-l4.title: Kalmomi bisa mahallin magana
en-h2-l4.concept: A yi amfani da alamun saɓani, misali, dalili da prefixes domin hasashen ma’anar kalmomin da ba a sani ba.

en-h2-l5.title: Ci gaban tunanin rubutu
en-h2-l5.concept: A bi tsarin rubutu ta hanyar gano abin da demonstratives ke nufi da kuma linking words, sannan a tattara bayanai dalla-dalla domin cimma ƙarshe.
en-h2-l5.example: In this way = ta wannan hanya

en-h3-l1.title: Parallel structure da subject-verb agreement
en-h3-l1.concept: Kalmomi ko jimlolin da and/but/or ya haɗa su su kasance da tsari iri ɗaya, kuma verb ya yi daidai da ainihin subject.

en-h3-l2.title: Yanayi, sautin magana da manufa
en-h3-l2.concept: A gano yanayin rubutu daga bayanin yanayi da kalmomin motsin rai; a gano manufarsa daga ko yana roƙo, bayar da bayani ko lallashi.

en-h3-l3.title: Tsarin jimloli da saka jimla
en-h3-l3.concept: A shirya jimloli kuma a nemo inda jimlar da aka bayar za ta shiga ta amfani da linking words, demonstratives da jerin lokaci.

en-h3-l4.title: Collocations da idioms
en-h3-l4.concept: A koyi kalmomin da ake yawan amfani da su tare, kamar make a decision, take a risk, heavy rain; a kuma yi hasashen ma’anar idiom daga yanayin magana.

en-h3-l5.title: Kammala taƙaitaccen bayani
en-h3-l5.concept: A gano muhimman ra’ayoyin rubutu da kalmomin saɓani, sannan a taƙaita su cikin jimla ɗaya.

en-h3e-l1.title: Zaɓen furuci da ya dace da yanayi
en-h3e-l1.concept: A tambayoyin tattaunawa, a duba ko nahawu daidai ne, kuma ko furucin ya dace da yanayin, ya kasance na ladabi kuma na halitta. Ana yawan samun bayar da shawara, katsewa, amsa yabo, idioms da faɗar abu a kaikaice.

en-h3e-l2.title: Furucin wurin aiki da collocations
en-h3e-l2.concept: A Turancin wurin aiki, muhimman abubuwa su ne idioms (touch base), abbreviations (ASAP da sauransu), da haɗuwar verb da preposition (collocations). Kada a fassara kalma-kalma; a haddace su a matsayin jimlolin da ake amfani da su a yanayin aiki.

en-h3e-l3.title: Karanta bayanai da tunani mai zurfi
en-h3e-l3.concept: A Turancin kafafen yaɗa labarai, yana da muhimmanci a bambanta gaskiya da ra’ayi, sannan a tantance ko hujjar da aka yi amfani da ita wajen goyon bayan iƙirari tana da inganci. A kuma haddace kalmomi kamar bayanin hoto (alt text, caption) da kayan gyara bisa manufarsu.

en-h3e-l4.title: Kalmomin al'adu da budaddiyar fahimta
en-h3e-l4.concept: A batutuwan al'adun duniya, koyi muhimman kalmomi kamar culture, diversity da stereotype, da furucin fahimtar wasu al'adu ba tare da yanke musu hukunci ba. Bambanta kalmomi masu kama da juna ta amfani da alamun mahalli.

en-h3e-l5.title: Karanta adabi ta amfani da kalmomin fasaha
en-h3e-l5.concept: A tambayoyin adabi, muhimmin abu shi ne sanin ma'anar kalmomin fasaha da amfani da su ga yanayin labari. Bambanta alamar abin da zai faru daga baya, alama, mahangar mai ba da labari, jigo, da matsayin jarumai.

en-h3e-l6.title: Bambanta hujja da kuskuren tunani
en-h3e-l6.concept: A muhawara, ana buƙatar iya bambanta kalmomin fasaha (motion, rebuttal da sauransu), nau'in shaida, da kuskuren tunani. Idan kana tantance da'awa, fara tambaya 'Menene hujjar wannan magana?'

en-h3e-l7.title: Rubuta daidai kuma bisa ga manufa
en-h3e-l7.concept: A rubutu, zaɓi tsari da ya dace da manufar rubutun da mai karatu, kuma ka bincika tsarin jimla (jigo da fi'ili) tare da alaƙar mahaɗan jimla. Rubutu mai takamaiman bayani kamar takardar neman aiki ya fi kyau idan ya bayyana aiki da lambobi maimakon magana marar takamaiman bayani.

en-l1.title: Koyon kalmomin yau da kullum
en-l1.concept: Za ka fi tuna kalmomin da ake yawan amfani da su idan ka koyi **sauti + ma'ana + rubutawa** tare. Danna maɓallin lasifika domin sauraron furuci.
en-l1.example: library = ɗakin karatu / desk = tebur / milk = madara

en-l2.title: Be-verb am / are / is
en-l2.concept: Siffar be-verb tana sauyawa bisa ga jigo. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.

en-l3.title: Lokacin yanzu na babban fi'ili
en-l3.concept: Idan jigo shi ne **he / she / it (mutum na uku, tilo)**, a ƙara **-s / -es** ga fi'ili. Idan fi'ili ya ƙare da -ch, -sh, -s, -x ko -o, a ƙara -es; idan baƙi+y ne, sauya y zuwa i sannan a ƙara -es!

en-l4.title: Jam'in suna da gina jimla
en-l4.concept: Idan suna ya nuna abubuwa fiye da ɗaya, yawanci a ƙara **-s**; idan ya ƙare da -x, a ƙara **-es**, kuma a haddace jam'i marar bin ƙa'ida dabam. Tsarin jimla shi ne **jigo → fi'ili → sauran kalmomi**.

en-m2-l1.title: Present perfect
en-m2-l1.concept: have/has + past participle. Yana nuna gogewa, abin da aka kammala, ko abin da ke ci gaba; bambanta since (lokacin farawa) da for (tsawon lokaci).

en-m2-l2.title: Passive voice
en-m2-l2.concept: be + past participle yana nuna ma'anar '~an yi/aka yi wa'. A ƙara mai aikatawa ta amfani da by.

en-m2-l3.title: To-infinitive da gerund
en-m2-l3.concept: want, hope, decide + to-infinitive; enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V yana nufin dakata domin wani abu, amma stop + V-ing yana nufin daina aikin.

en-m2-l4.title: Comparative da superlative
en-m2-l4.concept: -er/-est da more/most. A yi amfani da than tare da comparative, da the tare da superlative. good → better → best ba ya bin ƙa'ida.

en-m2-l5.title: Karatun fahimta: jigo da cikakkun bayanai
en-m2-l5.concept: Da farko karanta tambayar, sannan nemo jimlar da ke ɗauke da alama. Take da taƙaitaccen jigo suna bayyana babban batun rubutun gaba ɗaya.

en-m2-sum1.title: Taƙaita abin da rubutu ya ƙunsa
en-m2-sum1.concept: Idan kana taƙaita rubutu, nemo **babban ra'ayi** sannan ka rage shi zuwa jimla ɗaya ko biyu. Jimlar da ta faɗi ƙaramin bayani guda ɗaya, ta ƙara abin da ba ya cikin rubutun, ko ta yi magana mai faɗi fiye da kima ba kyakkyawar taƙaitawa ba ce.

en-m3-l1.title: Relative pronoun
en-m3-l1.concept: Haɗa jimloli biyu zuwa ɗaya ta amfani da who (mutum), which (abu), that (duka), ko whose (mallaka).

en-m3-l2.title: Conditional da yanayin zato na baya
en-m3-l2.concept: If + lokacin yanzu, will + V (abin da zai yiwu). If + lokacin baya, would + V (zato da ya saɓa wa gaskiyar yanzu).

en-m3-l3.title: Tambaya ta kai tsaye
en-m3-l3.concept: Rubuta kalmar tambaya + jigo + fi'ili a wannan tsari. Kada a yi amfani da do/does/did.

en-m3-l4.title: Participles
en-m3-l4.concept: -ing yana nuna aiki ko cigaba, -ed kuma karɓar aiki ko kammalawa. Idan abu ne ke haifar da ji, yi amfani da -ing; idan ana jin sa, yi amfani da -ed.

en-m3-l5.title: Fahimtar rubutu: Hasashe da Manufar Rubutu
en-m3-l5.concept: Haɗa alamomi domin yin hasashe, sannan gano manufar rubutu ta amfani da buƙatu ko da’awa.

e-h3e-job-4.explanation: Amsa daidai ita ce at. Ana amfani da tsarin be good at ~ing wajen magana game da ƙwarewa. good of ana amfani da shi wajen yabon abin kirki da mutum ya yi, ba wajen bayyana ƙwarewa ba.
hints: Ka tuna da harafin da aka saba haɗawa da sifa good a wannan karin magana.
Bayan kalmar akwai solving, wato suna da aka samo daga fi’ili; ka nemi harafin da ake amfani da shi wajen cewa mutum ya ƙware a wani abu.

e-h3e-job-5.explanation: Amsa daidai ita ce for your information. Ma’anarta ita ce “ina sanar da kai don bayaninka,” kuma ana yawan amfani da ita a imel. for your invitation tana da F, Y, I ɗin daidai, amma invitation na nufin gayyata don haka ma’anar ta bambanta.
hints: Buɗe gajeriyar magana ta hanyar amfani da harafin farko na kowace kalma, sannan ka tabbatar da cewa ta dace da manufar saƙon.
Manufar ita ce sanar da mai karɓa wani abu a farkon saƙo. Kwatanta kalmomin da ke wakiltar F, Y, I a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan.

e-h3e-job-d1.explanation: Kalmar person bayan gurbin ita ce suna, don haka reliable (abin dogaro) sifa ce da ta dace ta bayyana ta. reliably kalmar bayani ce, ba za ta iya bayyana suna ba.
hints: Waɗannan kalmomi huɗu sun fito daga tushe ɗaya, don haka muhimmin abu shi ne nau'in kalma, ba ma'anarta ba. Da farko ka gano aikin da gurbin yake yi a jimla.
Duba nau'in kalmar da ke nan take bayan gurbin, sannan ka yi tunani kan irin nau'in kalmar da ke bayyana wannan kalma.

e-h3e-lit-1.explanation: Amsa ita ce foreshadowing (alamar abin da zai faru nan gaba). Wata hanya ce ta yin nuni tun da wuri ga abin da zai faru daga baya. flashback komawa ne ga wani yanayi na baya, don haka ba nuni ne ga abin da zai faru nan gaba ba.
hints: Ka tuna da ma'anar kalmar adabi sannan ka danganta ta da jerin abubuwan da suka faru. A wane lokaci a cikin labarin wannan dabara take aiki?
Duba yadda lokacin da aka ambaci cewa gadar tana raunana yake da alaƙa da lokacin da gadar ta rushe.

e-h3e-lit-2.explanation: Amsa ita ce peace. Farar kurciya alama ce ta gargajiya ta zaman lafiya a cikin adabi. danger bai dace da yanayin wurin da aka nuna ƙarshen yaƙi ba.
hints: A cikin waƙa, dabbobi ko abubuwa na iya zama alamomi. Ka haɗa su da yanayin wurin da suka bayyana.
Ka yi tunanin yanayin da mutane suke fata bayan yaƙi ya ƙare, sannan ka nemo kalmar da ke nufin wannan yanayin.

e-h3e-lit-3.explanation: Amsa ita ce omniscient (mai sanin komai) viewpoint. Wannan saboda an san tunanin mutane da dama. limited viewpoint yana bayyana tunanin mutum ɗaya ne kawai, don haka bai dace da misalin da ke nuna tunanin mutane biyu ba.
hints: A tambayar ra'ayi, duba wanda yake magana da kuma tunanin mutane nawa mai ba da labari ya sani.
Duba ko misalin yana ba da labarin tunanin Anna da Tom duka, sannan ka zaɓi ra'ayin da ya dace da wannan iyaka.

e-h3e-lit-4.explanation: Amsa ita ce Kindness often comes back to those who give it. Tana bayyana alaƙar sanadi da sakamako a labarin a matsayin tunani na gama-gari game da rayuwa. The story takes place in a market bayani ne kawai game da wurin da labarin ya faru, ba jigon labarin ba.
hints: Jigo ba taƙaitaccen labari ko wurin da ya faru ba ne; tunani ne na gama-gari da labarin yake bayyanawa game da rayuwa.
Ka duba ko an mayar da alaƙar aikin yaron da sakamakonsa zuwa jimla guda ta gama-gari, kuma ko ba ta faɗi akasin labarin ba.

e-h3e-lit-5.explanation: Amsa ita ce protagonist (jarumin labari). Yana da wata manufa a tsakiyar labarin kuma yana jagorantar abubuwan da ke faruwa. antagonist mutum ne da yake adawa da jarumin, don haka rawar tasu akasin juna ce.
hints: Ana bambanta kalmomin rawar jarumai bisa ayyukansu. Babban jarumi, wanda yake adawa da shi, da mai ba da labari mutane ne masu ayyuka dabam-dabam.
Kwatanta bayanin ‘wants something and drives the action’ a tambayar da ma'anar kalmomin da ke cikin zaɓuɓɓukan.

e-h3e-lit-d1.explanation: Tsarin da baƙaƙen sauti masu ƙarfi da marasa ƙarfi suke maimaituwa a kai a kai shi ne rhythm (meter). plot structure yana nufin jerin yadda abubuwan da suka faru suke gudana, ba shi da alaƙa da sauti.
hints: Ka sake faɗin ma'anar tambayar (stressed and unstressed syllables, regular pattern) da kalmominka a jimla guda, sannan ka zaɓi amsar da ta dace da ma'anar.
Idan stressed da unstressed syllables suna musanya juna, wane irin ji ne ake samu yayin furta su? Nemo kalmar da ke nufin wannan ji.

e-h3e-media-1.explanation: Amsa ita ce bayyana hoto ga mutumin da ba ya iya ganinsa. Madadin rubutu yana sanar da abun cikin hoto ta hanyar shirin karanta allo ko idan hoton bai bayyana ba. Toshe kwafi aiki ne na wata fasaha dabam.
hints: Ka fassara sunan kalmar. alt taƙaitacciyar kalmar alternative (madadi) ce.
Ka yi tunanin wanda wannan aikin yake taimaka wa da kuma halin da ake ciki; daga nan ka fara cire zaɓin da bai da alaƙa da manufar.

e-h3e-media-2.explanation: Amsa ita ce The new park is the most beautiful place in town. Kyawun abu ra'ayi ne da ya bambanta daga mutum zuwa mutum. Ana iya tabbatar da watan buɗewa, girman fili, da yawan wuraren wasan yara a matsayin gaskiya.
hints: Ana iya tabbatar da gaskiya, yayin da ra'ayi ya bambanta daga mutum zuwa mutum. Ka tantance ko za a iya tabbatar da kowace jimla.
Duba ko bayani ne da za a iya tabbatarwa kamar kwanan wata, girman fili ko adadi, ko kuma akwai kalmomin kimantawa a ciki.

e-h3e-media-3.explanation: Amsa daidai ita ce cewa shayi ne ya sa ta ji sauƙi. Jin sauƙi bayan shan shayi kaɗai bai tabbatar da cewa shayin ne ya jawo hakan ba. formal style salo ne kawai, ba raunin tunani ba.
hints: A taƙaita yadda tallan ya wuce daga hujja zuwa ƙarshe. Sai ka tambayi kanka ko hujjar kaɗai ta isa ta tabbatar da ƙarshe. Ka kuma duba ko zaɓin yana magana ne game da alaƙar tunani ko kamannin rubutu kawai.
Ka mai da hankali kan yadda aka danganta shan shayi da samun sauƙi don cimma ƙarshe. Ka cire zaɓin da ke magana game da kalmomi ko salo.

e-h3e-media-4.explanation: Amsa daidai ita ce Students gather with balloons at the annual school fair. Dalibai, balan-balan, da bikin makaranta duk sun dace da abin da ke hoton. Zaɓi kamar mai tsere shi kaɗai yana ketare layin ƙarshe ba ya kama da hoton ko kaɗan.
hints: Rubutun hoton ya kamata ya bayyana mutanen, wurin, da abin da ake yi waɗanda suke bayyana a hoton da gaske.
Da farko ka rubuta mutanen, wurin, da kayayyakin da aka ambata a yanayin tambayar, sannan ka kwatanta yadda kowace amsa ta yi daidai da su.

e-h3e-media-5.explanation: Amsa daidai ita ce Track changes. Yana nuna canje-canjen da aka yi domin a gabatar da gyara ba tare da goge ainihin rubutun ba. Print preview yana nuna yadda takarda za ta fito idan an buga kawai, ba shi da alaƙa da gabatar da shawarwarin gyara.
hints: Ka fayyace abin da ake buƙata: a ba da shawarar gyara, amma a bar ainihin rubutun.
Ka bincika ko kowane zaɓi yana da alaƙa da gyaran takarda, kuma idan haka ne, ko yana nuna canje-canje yayin da yake kiyaye ainihin rubutun.

e-h3e-media-d1.explanation: echo chamber na nufin ƙungiyar da mutane ke ci gaba da jin ra’ayi iri ɗaya da nasu, har ra’ayinsu ya ƙara ƙarfi. Dakin hira da ke maimaita saƙo sau biyu yana maimaita sauti ko rubutu kai tsaye ne kawai, ba shi da alaƙa da nuna son kai a ra’ayi.
hints: echo chamber furuci ne na misali, ba ainihin ɗaki ba. Ka yi tunanin abin da amon sauti yake wakilta a intanet.
Ka yi tunanin abin da ke ci gaba da dawowa kamar amon sauti, sannan ka bambanta zaɓin da ya shafi sauti da wanda ya shafi tunanin mutane.

e-h3e-world-1.explanation: Amsa daidai ita ce harshen da mutanen da harsunansu na asali suka bambanta suke amfani da shi. Rawar da Turanci ke takawa wajen sadarwar ƙasashen duniya misali ne. Harshen da iyali ɗaya kawai ke amfani da shi ba zai iya zama yaren gama-gari ba.
hints: Kada furucin Latin da ba a sani ba ya ruɗe ka. Da farko ka kwatanta yadda kowace amsa ta bayyana “waye yake amfani da wannan harshe,” sannan ka fara cire amsoshin da sharadinsu ya yi ƙunci ko bai yi ma’ana ba.
Ka kwatanta su wanene ke amfani da harshen a kowace amsa da irin dangantakar da ke tsakaninsu.

e-h3e-world-2.explanation: Amsa daidai ita ce stereotype. Tana nufin imani mai sauƙaƙa fiye da kima game da dukan wata ƙungiya. dialect na nufin salon magana na yanki, ba imani game da mutane ba.
hints: A tambayar ma’ana, ka gano mahimman kalmomi. oversimplified da whole group su ne mabuɗin.
Da farko ka rarraba abin da kowace kalma ke nufi: ra’ayi game da ƙungiya, salon magana, biki, ko iyali.

e-h3e-world-3.explanation: Amsa daidai ita ce diversity. cultural diversity na nufin bambancin al’adu. division na nufin “rarrabuwa, rabewa,” don haka yana da ma’ana saɓani da bayanin cewa suna rayuwa tare.
hints: Idan kalmomi sun yi kama a rubutu, ka kwatanta ma’anarsu bisa bayanin da ya zo bayan gurbi.
Ka kwatanta bayanin mutanen asali dabam-dabam suna rayuwa tare da ma’anar suna da ya dace ya biyo bayan cultural.

e-h3e-world-4.explanation: Amsa daidai ita ce Their customs are different from ours, and I would like to learn why. Wannan hali ne na amincewa da bambanci da son koyo. Kalmomi kamar strange and backward suna raina al’adar wasu.
hints: A tambayar fahimtar al’adu, ka duba ko ana yi wa wata al’ada hukunci ko ana ƙoƙarin fahimtarta.
Ka bincika ko akwai kalmomin da ke yin jimilla ko kwatanta al’adu a matsayin masu daraja ko marasa daraja, kamar all, wrong, backward.

e-h3e-world-5.explanation: Amsa daidai ita ce authentic. Ma’anarta ita ce “na gaske, abin yarda.” artificial na nufin abin ƙarya da mutum ya ƙera, ma’ana kishiyarta.
hints: Ka maye gurbin muhimmin kalmar genuine a bayanin ma’ana da kalmomi masu sauƙi.
Ka yi tunanin kishiyar “not copied,” sannan ka fara cire zaɓin da ke da ma’anar kishiyar.

e-h3e-world-d1.explanation: Indigenous yana nufin mutanen da suka daɗe suna zaune a wani yanki, ko abin da ya samo asali daga wannan ƙasa. Foreign yana nufin wanda ya fito daga wata ƙasa, don haka ma'anarsa kishiyar wannan ce.
hints: Karanta ma'anar, ka gano muhimmin ra'ayi, sannan ka daidaita ma'anar kowace kalma da ita.
Ka mai da hankali ga sashen “the first people who lived in a region”. Ka nemo kalmar da ta dace da wannan ma'ana a cikin kalmomin da suka shafi shahara, zamani ko asali.

e-h3e-write-1.explanation: Amsa ita ce makes. 'make a case for' tsayayyen haɗin kalmomi ne da ke nufin gabatar da hujjoji don goyon bayan wani abu, don haka ya dace da rahoton da ke gabatar da hujjoji. does fi'ili ne na gaba ɗaya, kuma haɗa shi da 'a case for' ba ya yi kyau.
hints: Ana koyon haɗin fi'ili da suna a matsayin ma'aurata, ba ta ma'anarsu kaɗai ba. Ka tuna da fi'ilin da ake amfani da shi tare da a case.
Ka kwatanta fi'ilin da ake yawan haɗawa da case don nuna cewa rahoto yana gabatar da hujjoji.

e-h3e-write-2.explanation: Amsa ita ce Organized a school recycling campaign that collected 300 kilograms of paper. Tana farawa da fi'ili kuma tana bayyana aikin da aka yi da sakamakon da aka samu. Helped with various things ... ba ya bayyana ainihin aikin da aka yi ba.
hints: Takardar neman aiki tana nuna sakamako a sarari kuma a taƙaice. Ka guji kalmomi marasa takamaiman bayani.
Ka kwatanta ko kowane zaɓi yana bayyana takamaiman aiki, ko ra'ayin mutum ne kawai ko bayani marar takamaiman bayani.

e-h3e-write-3.explanation: Amsa ita ce Although the museum was crowded, we stayed for three hours. Ko da yake wurin ya cika da mutane, mun daɗe a ciki; Although ya nuna wannan saɓani yadda ya dace. 'so we left after a short time' ya saɓa da gaskiyar cewa mun daɗe a wurin.
hints: Kafin haɗa jimloli biyu, fara tantance alaƙar da ke tsakaninsu: sanadi, saɓani ko lokaci.
Ka yi tunanin ko cunkoson wurin da zama na sa'o'i 3 suna tafiya tare da abin da ake tsammani ko kuwa suna saɓani.

e-h3e-write-4.explanation: Amsa ita ce The students who joined the club met every Friday. Jigon The students yana da babban fi'ilin met. Zaɓin da ya fara da Because ƙaramar jimla ce, don haka ba ta cika ba saboda ba ta bayyana abin da ya biyo baya.
hints: Cikakkiyar jimla tana da jigo da babban fi'ili kuma ma'anarta ta cika. Kada sashen dangantaka, sashen da ya fara da mahaɗin jimla ko gungun kalmomin da suka ƙare da -ing su ruɗe ka.
Nemo babban fi'ilin da ke nuna lokaci a kowanne zaɓi. Ka ware kalmomin da suka zo bayan who ko because don duba tsarin jimlar.

e-h3e-write-5.explanation: Amsa ita ce an opinion letter to the board. Idan manufar ita ce lallashi, wasiƙar ra'ayi mai gabatar da hujjoji ita ce ta dace. diary entry rubutun sirri ne, ba rubutun lallashin kwamitin makaranta ba.
hints: Manufar rubutu (lallashi, bayani ko rubutun abubuwan da suka faru) da mai karatu suna taimaka wajen zaɓar nau'in rubutu.
Ka yi tunanin wanda ake rubuta wa da abin da ake nema, sannan ka nemo tsarin rubutu da ya dace da manufar.

e-h3e-write-d1.explanation: A matakin editing, ana gano kurakuran nahawu, rubutu da alamomin rubutu a rubutun da aka kammala, sannan a gyara su. Tattara ra'ayoyi aikin brainstorming ne (matakin prewriting), don haka ya bambanta da editing.
hints: Matakan rubutu suna da tsari. Ka tuna abin da ake yi yayin tsarawa, rubuta daftari, sake dubawa da gyarawa, sannan ka zaɓi bayanin da ya dace da matakin gyarawa.
Ana yin editing bayan kusan an kammala rubutun. Ka rarrabe zaɓuɓɓukan da ke magana kan shirya rubutu kafin a fara da waɗanda ke gyara rubutun da aka riga aka rubuta.

e-m2-comp-1.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace don gurbin da babu komai: My bag is ____ than yours.
hints: Ga siffofi gajeru, a yi amfani da -er/-est; ga siffofi dogaye, a yi amfani da more/most. Ana amfani da than kafin abin da ake kwatantawa da shi.
Tunda akwai than, sifar kwatantawa ake buƙata. A sauya y na heavy zuwa ier.

e-m2-comp-2.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace don gurbin da babu komai: This is the ____ movie I have ever seen.
hints: Ga siffofi gajeru, a yi amfani da -er/-est; ga siffofi dogaye, a yi amfani da more/most. Ana amfani da than kafin abin da ake kwatantawa da shi.
Ma'anar ita ce 'mafi ... a cikin duk abin da na taɓa gani', saboda haka ana buƙatar sifa mafi girma. interesting sifa ce doguwa.

e-m2-comp-3.prompt: Zaɓi jimlar da ba ta dace da nahawu ba (wadda ba daidai ba ce).
e-m2-comp-3.explanation: Daidai shi ne hotter than (a maimaita harafin t sau ɗaya).
hints: Ga siffofi gajeru, a yi amfani da -er/-est; ga siffofi dogaye, a yi amfani da more/most. Ana amfani da than kafin abin da ake kwatantawa da shi.
hot sifa ce gajera, saboda haka ba a amfani da more tare da ita.

e-m2-comp-4.prompt: Karanta rubutun ka amsa. "Amy is 150 cm tall. Ben is 158 cm tall. Chris is 154 cm tall." Tambaya: Who is the tallest?
e-m2-comp-4.explanation: Ben mai tsawon 158 cm ne the tallest.
hints: Kwatanta tsayin mutanen ukun duka, sannan ka nemo mafi tsayi.

e-m2-comp-5.prompt: Karanta rubutun ka amsa. "A bike costs $120. A scooter costs $180. A skateboard costs $90." Tambaya: Which sentence is correct?
e-m2-comp-5.explanation: Tunda $180 > $120, scooter ya fi bike tsada.
hints: Ana amfani da -er/-est ga sifa gajeriya, sannan more/most ga doguwar sifa. Ana amfani da than bayan abin da ake kwatantawa da shi.
Jera farashin $90 < $120 < $180, sannan ka duba kowace zaɓi.

e-m2-comp-d1.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace da gurbi: This room is ____ than that one.
hints: Ana amfani da -er/-est ga sifa gajeriya, sannan more/most ga doguwar sifa. Ana amfani da than bayan abin da ake kwatantawa da shi.
Tunda akwai than, ana buƙatar sigar kwatantawa.

e-m2-comp-d2.prompt: Zaɓi jimlar da ba ta dace da nahawu ba.
e-m2-comp-d2.explanation: Tunda an ambaci in Korea, dole ne a yi amfani da sigar fifiko.
hints: Ana amfani da -er/-est ga sifa gajeriya, sannan more/most ga doguwar sifa. Ana amfani da than bayan abin da ake kwatantawa da shi.
Don nuna ma’anar “mafi ... cikin ...”, a yi amfani da the tare da sifa a sigar fifiko.

e-m2-comp-v1.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace da gurbi: Mt. Everest is the ____ mountain in the world.
hints: Sigar fifiko ta good ita ce best (ba bisa ƙa’ida ba).
Tunda akwai the, ana buƙatar sigar fifiko.

e-m2-comp-v2.prompt: Zaɓi ko jimlar nan daidai ce a nahawu: He is more taller than me.
e-m2-comp-v2.explanation: Ba a amfani da more tare da -er a lokaci guda: taller than me.
hints: Ana amfani da -er/-est ga sifa gajeriya, sannan more/most ga doguwar sifa. Ana amfani da than bayan abin da ake kwatantawa da shi.
A cikin taller akwai -er tun farko.

e-m2-comp-v3.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace da gurbi: She is the ____ student in our class.
hints: Sigar fifiko ta good ita ce best (ba bisa ƙa’ida ba).
Tunda akwai the, ana amfani da sigar fifiko.

e-m2-inf-1.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace da gurbi: I want ____ a new bike.
e-m2-inf-1.explanation: want to buy ne ya dace.
hints: Bayan want, hope, decide ana amfani da to-infinitive; bayan enjoy, finish, mind ana amfani da gerund (-ing).
want yana ɗaukar to-infinitive a matsayin object.

e-m2-inf-2.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace da gurbi: She enjoys ____ to music.
hints: Bayan want, hope, decide ana amfani da to-infinitive; bayan enjoy, finish, mind ana amfani da gerund (-ing).
enjoy yana ɗaukar gerund a matsayin object.

e-m2-inf-3.prompt: Zaɓi jimlar da ba ta dace da nahawu ba.
e-m2-inf-3.explanation: Bayan decide, ana amfani da to-infinitive, don haka decided to go ne daidai.
hints: Bayan want, hope, decide ana amfani da to-infinitive; bayan enjoy, finish, mind ana amfani da gerund (-ing).
Duba wane nau’i ne decide yake buƙata.

e-m2-inf-4.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace da gurbin tattaunawar. A: Why did you stop on the way? B: I stopped ____ some water because I was thirsty.
e-m2-inf-4.explanation: Ana nuna manufa, saboda haka stopped to buy ne.
hints: stop + to-infinitive na nufin “tsayawa domin yin wani abu”; stop + gerund na nufin “daina yin wani abu.”
Ya tsaya ne da manufar sayen ruwa.

e-m2-inf-5.prompt: Karanta rubutun, sannan ka amsa. "Ben likes swimming. He wants to join the swimming team, but he has not decided when to start." Tambaya: Which sentence is TRUE?
e-m2-inf-5.explanation: A cikin rubutun, Ben yana son shiga team ɗin (wants to join).
hints: Kwatanta kowace zaɓi da jimlolin rubutun ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
'has not decided' yana nufin har yanzu bai yanke shawara ba.

e-m2-inf-d1.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace a cikin gurbi: He avoids ____ late.
hints: Bayan want, hope, decide, ana amfani da to-infinitive; bayan enjoy, finish, mind, ana amfani da gerund (-ing).
avoid yana buƙatar gerund.

e-m2-inf-d2.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace a cikin gurbi: I'm looking forward to ____ you.
hints: to a cikin look forward to preposition ne, saboda haka gerund yana zuwa bayansa.
Bayan to, a yi amfani da siffar -ing maimakon base form na verb.

e-m2-inf-v1.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace a cikin gurbi: They finished ____ the project.
hints: Bayan want, hope, decide, ana amfani da to-infinitive; bayan enjoy, finish, mind, ana amfani da gerund (-ing).
finish yana buƙatar gerund.

e-m2-inf-v2.prompt: Zaɓi ko wannan jimla daidai ce ta fuskar nahawu: I enjoy to swim.
e-m2-inf-v2.explanation: I enjoy swimming. shi ne daidai.
hints: Bayan want, hope, decide, ana amfani da to-infinitive; bayan enjoy, finish, mind, ana amfani da gerund (-ing).
Yi amfani da gerund bayan enjoy.

e-m2-inf-v3.prompt: Zaɓi kalmar da ta dace a cikin gurbi: She hopes ____ abroad next year.
hints: Bayan want, hope, decide, ana amfani da to-infinitive; bayan enjoy, finish, mind, ana amfani da gerund (-ing).
hope yana buƙatar to-infinitive.
